title: Roofing Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Roofing Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
standard: OSHA 29 Cfr 1926 Subpart M - Fall Protection
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: ROOF-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ ROOF TYPE: ☐ Flat ☐ Sloped ☐ Steep

ROOFER: ______________ HEIGHT: ______________ ft PITCH: ______________ /12 CREW SIZE: ___________

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Material Hoisting & Loading-Heavy bundles
-Unstable load
-Crane/swing radius
-Weather		-Back strain
-Dropped material
-Struck by
-Wind event		12 (HIGH)-Team lifting
-Use mechanical lift equipment
-Barricade drop zone (1.5x height)
-Tag lines on all loads
-Stop if wind >25mph
2. Roof Access & Edge Setup-No anchor points
-Unprotected edges
-Ladder slips		-Fall from roof edge
-Death		25 (VERY HIGH)-100% tie-off at all times
-Install guardrails at edges
-Use personal fall arrest system
-Anchor points rated 5000lbs
-Secure ladders at top
3. Roof Preparation (Tear-off)-Heat stress
-Falling tools
-Nail guns
-Sharp edges
-Dust		-Heat stroke
-Tool drop
-Puncture wounds
-Lacerations		16 (HIGH)-Schedule work for cool hours
-Provide water and shade
-Use tool lanyards
-Magnetic sweep for nails
-Heavy gloves/pads
4. Underlay & Felt Installation-Slips on sloped surface
-Unsecured felt rolls
-Loose debris		-Fall from roof
-Roll from roof		20 (VERY HIGH)-Use slip-resistant shoes
-Maintain 100% tie-off
-Install roof brackets
-Secure rolls when not in use
-Keep work area clear
5. Material Application (Torch/ Hot Tar)-Hot kettle
-Fumes
-Fire hazard
-Torch operation		-Burns
-Inhalation
-Roof fire
-Explosion		15 (HIGH)-Use kettle with temperature control
-Position kettle away from traffic
-Fire extinguisher within 25ft
-Check for combustibles
-Ventilate work area
6. Shingle Installation (Sloped)-Nail gun accidents
-Loose shingles
-Tool drop
-Overreaching		-Puncture wounds
-Slide from roof
-Fall		12 (HIGH)-Use nail gun safety features
-Keep hands clear of nailing path
-Maintain tie-off
-Secure unused shingles
-Work within safe reach
7. Flashing & Edge Work-Ladders on sloped roof
-Metal edges
-Sealant fumes		-Ladder slip
-Fall
-Lacerations
-Inhalation		12 (HIGH)-Secure all ladders
-Use roof brackets
-Wear cut-resistant gloves
-Use proper ventilation
-Dispose of sharp material properly
8. Cleanup & Debris Removal-Leftover materials
-Loose nails
-Loading dumpster		-Trips
-Falling debris
-Back injury		8 (MODERATE)-Daily clean-up
-Debris chute for disposal
-Magnetic sweep
-Mechanical handling
-Close dumpster lid

FALL PROTECTION SYSTEM: ☐ Guardrails ☐ Safety Net ☐ Personal Fall Arrest ☐ Warning Line ☐ Safety Monitor
